import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
e=np.asarray(df['eps']);t=np.asarray(df['T']);s=np.asarray(df['sigma'])
def fit(f,p0):
    best=None
    for sc in [0.5,1,2]:
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-s, np.array(p0,float)*sc, max_nfev=20000)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception: pass
    return best.x, np.mean((f(best.x)-s)**2)/np.var(s)
f=lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*(1-np.exp(-p[2]*e))+p[3]*e
p,v=fit(f,[1,10,1,0.1]); r=f(p)-s
print(np.round(p,4),v)
print('corr resid-T',np.corrcoef(r,t)[0,1],'resid-e',np.corrcoef(r,e)[0,1])
for lo in np.arange(2,6,0.5):
